items.title: AICTE National Internship Portal
items.org: All India Council for Technical Education
items.description: Internships from ministries, public sector units, urban local bodies and industry for AICTE, UGC and IGNOU students. Use the portal to check live roles, stipend and deadlines.

items.title: Google Summer of Code
items.description: Global open-source contribution programme where selected participants work with mentoring organisations. Eligibility and the annual application window vary; confirm current dates on the official site.
